name: gate
desc: Does this apply at all? A threshold condition that opens or closes the whole analysis.

examples.software: Is this feature available in this version?

name: element
desc: A required component that must be present for an outcome (ingredients, criteria, field marks).

name: cue
desc: An observable signal that indicates a condition (evidence, symptom, metric).

name: distinction
desc: The deciding difference between look-alike outcomes.

name: sequence
desc: An ordered series of steps or an order of examination.

name: exception
desc: Something that defeats or modifies an otherwise valid conclusion.

name: decision
desc: Choosing an outcome or action once conditions are known.

name: craft
desc: How the author writes: structure, voice, devices, narration, rhythm.
